inputs.text: [excited] He was 0.7 meters long — like a big cat stretched out! [amazed] Standing up, it would come up to your knees! And he weighed 17 kilos — [serious] as heavy as a 4-year-old! [curious] Scientists think he could move about 3 miles an hour — as fast as you when you walk.
[chuckles] Small, but tough, yes — [proud] and above all, incredibly hardy.
